shots.run: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const btn = (t) => [...document.querySelectorAll('main button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === t); const until = async (f) => { for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !f(); i++) await wait(250); }; const tag = (el, name) => { el.dataset.shot = name; }; await until(() => btn('Search all')); const cfg = await api('/api/config'); window.shotHours = cfg.download_hours; const hr = new Date().getHours(); await api('/api/config/general', { method: 'PUT', body: { download_hours: { enabled: true, start: (hr + 2) % 24, end: (hr + 3) % 24 } } }); await wait(500); wantedState.paused = (await api('/api/schedule')).mode === 'pause'; await wantedLoad(); await wait(800); tag([...document.querySelectorAll('main button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim().startsWith('Download now')), 'now');
shots.after: await api('/api/config/general', { method: 'PUT', body: { download_hours: window.shotHours || { enabled: false, start: 1, end: 6 } } });
